mainEntity.name: What equipment is typically used in a functional-fitness strength and conditioning gym like Cave Training?

acceptedAnswer.text: In a functional-fitness strength and conditioning gym like Cave Training, you'll typically find a variety of equipment designed to support dynamic, multi-joint movements rather than isolated muscle work. This often includes barbells, dumbbells, kettlebells, medicine balls, resistance bands, pull-up bars, and often equipment for plyometrics and agility drills. The focus is on versatility and movements that translate to real-world activities. We prioritize equipment that facilitates compound exercises and promotes full-body conditioning.
acceptedAnswer.description: Functional-fitness gyms like Cave Training use diverse equipment such as barbells, kettlebells, and resistance bands to support dynamic, multi-joint movements and full-body conditioning.
